tasks.title: Verify build + full test suite + scratch render
tasks.description: Final verification pass. (1) Run `bun test` from project root — all tests must pass. (2) Run `bun run build` — must succeed. (3) Render each prompt against the live `.ralph/instructions.md` (which contains '* Always use TDD across all task execution') and confirm the PERSONAL INSTRUCTIONS block appears in each: use a scratch script (or inline `bun -e`) to call `buildSystemPrompt` (run.ts), `buildDynamicContext` (plan.ts), `buildUserPrompt` (summarize.ts), and `buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt` (post-task-reviewer.ts), and assert each rendered string includes both 'PERSONAL INSTRUCTIONS:' and 'Always use TDD'. (4) In the commit message, include a ROLLOUT note: 'Users with existing Ralph installs must re-run `ralph init` in their projects to pick up the updated .claude/commands/*.md files.' Report which prompts got the block and any discrepancies in task notes.
tasks.notes:
Verification complete. (1) bun test: 595 pass / 0 fail across 23 files. (2) bun run build: dist/ralph compiled successfully in 194ms. (3) Rendered all four prompts against live .ralph/instructions.md via a scratch bun script and asserted each contained both 'PERSONAL INSTRUCTIONS:' and 'Always use TDD':
  - buildSystemPrompt (run.ts): OK
  - buildDynamicContext (plan.ts): OK
  - buildUserPrompt (summarize.ts): OK
  - buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt (post-task-reviewer.ts): OK
No discrepancies. All four production prompt builders inject the personal-instructions block via the shared loadPersonalInstructions() helper from src/personal-instructions.ts. Scratch script was removed after verification. ROLLOUT note included in commit message.
